## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Given two branches, /reconcile produces a reconciliation matrix in which...

The system SHALL ensure that given two branches, /reconcile produces a reconciliation matrix in which every conflicting item names an owner and a pending decision.

#### Scenario: Given two branches, /reconcile produces a reconciliation matrix in which...

WHEN `reconcile-skill` is implemented
THEN Given two branches, /reconcile produces a reconciliation matrix in which every conflicting item names an owner and a pending decision.

### Requirement: The output change validates with openspec validate --strict and includes the...

The system SHALL ensure that the output change validates with openspec validate --strict and includes the reconciled test union as acceptance tests.

#### Scenario: The output change validates with openspec validate --strict and includes the...

WHEN `reconcile-skill` is implemented
THEN The output change validates with openspec validate --strict and includes the reconciled test union as acceptance tests.

### Requirement: Given two competing proposals for one capability, the workflow emits a...

The system SHALL ensure that given two competing proposals for one capability, the workflow emits a kernel/backlog split with no requirement from either proposal silently dropped.

#### Scenario: Given two competing proposals for one capability, the workflow emits a...

WHEN `reconcile-skill` is implemented
THEN Given two competing proposals for one capability, the workflow emits a kernel/backlog split with no requirement from either proposal silently dropped.

### Requirement: /reconcile runs with only the git remote available, and conflicts between...

The system SHALL ensure that /reconcile runs with only the git remote available, and conflicts between principals' intents are escalated rather than resolved by the agent.

#### Scenario: /reconcile runs with only the git remote available, and conflicts between...

WHEN `reconcile-skill` is implemented
THEN /reconcile runs with only the git remote available, and conflicts between principals' intents are escalated rather than resolved by the agent.
